actions.summary: Board adopted an AI policy that leaves the call to teachers: an educator may authorize AI for brainstorming, review or open-ended problem solving, or bar it. Unauthorized use is treated as plagiarism, AI-generated fake or derogatory images of real people are prohibited, and the district must give age-appropriate instruction on responsible use, digital citizenship and privacy risk.
actions.notes: Adopted ahead of Ohio's statutory July 2026 deadline for every district to have an AI policy; built on the Ohio Department of Education and Workforce model policy. Ohio's largest district. Enrollment approximate.
